Storybook is aligned and buildable, Vite dependency discovery is scoped to the application entry, the B2 Project-to-Target-to-Work journey has an isolated self-cleaning two-viewport browser gate, shared close controls are localized and keyboard-dismissable, observed UI flakes are stable under the full UI suite, and a measured bundle baseline is enforced in PR and release verification.
